name: Mesh Spine
description: Meshes the speech sequence with music selection into a unified audio and timed spine.

inputs.name: brand_content
inputs.description: Brand template content slots. Only content.bookends is read: it declares the intro / outro / end card this template gets, and a template declaring none gets none.

inputs.name: creative_direction
inputs.description: The vision, from step 2.01. This step decides where every non-speech gap goes, how long it is, and the music_behavior of every block - including a planned silence - and its own handoff names the creative direction as one of three core reads and scores it on 'the spine follows the creative direction's energy arc'. It was never routed: on the 2026-08-26 run of record the model justified the silent climax by quoting 2.01's energy_arc, and that sentence was in no part of this step's context. Only key_moments and rationale are projected away - see context_fields.

inputs.name: clip_catalog
inputs.description: Clip identity. The vision documents are keyed by file stem and everything else in this step is keyed clip_XXX, so without the catalog a footage card cannot be tied to the clip a passage came from (AGENTS.md 10.1).

inputs.name: project_config
inputs.description: State input: project_config - the project's own declarations. `get_target_duration_zone` reads target_duration_seconds off it; without one the spine contract's duration zone is not checked.

inputs.name: semantic_analysis_documents
inputs.description: Per-clip vision documents. The spine commits the edit to N seconds of non-speech picture, so it has to know what picture the footage actually holds; without this the transition_slot durations were chosen from the transcript alone.

inputs.name: speech_sequence
inputs.description: State input: speech_sequence. Step 2.02 runs on every run and always emits - a speechless edit carries an empty body_sequence, never an absence. The post_bridge resolves passage_refs against whatever body is there (zero of zero is covered) and refuses only a speech/hook block nothing can resolve. Surveyed by library/tools/input_contract.py.

inputs.name: temporal_index
inputs.description: State input: temporal_index. OPTIONAL, and nothing reads it: the post_bridge never names it and `context_fields` does not select it, so the projection deletes it before the prompt. Declaring it required made a step that cannot use it refuse to run without it. Surveyed by library/tools/input_contract.py.

inputs.name: timeline_notes
inputs.description: The captain's own notes typed onto the built timeline in DaVinci Resolve, routed to this step because this step owns the decision each note is about. Injected by the runner from <project>/marker_feedback/ and absent when there are none. See library/tools/marker_routing.py.

inputs.name: creative_brief
inputs.description: The captain's creative direction as markdown, injected by the runner from the project's creative_brief path. Empty when the project declares none. This step sets every gap length and every music_behavior and was the only planning step of the seven with no brief (audit round 2 F7, round 3 B9/R9). Its handoff.md now names the brief in its own 'Creative Brief' section, added when the captain's freeze on that file lifted 2026-09-09; this declaration is what routes it. The runner restores the value around the projection BY NAME, so context_fields neither has to list it nor can drop it (AGENTS.md 10.1).

inputs.name: project_context
inputs.description: The project's context folder plus the learnings routed to this step, as a MAP the model follows with its shell (never a copy). Injected by the runner from the project's context/ folder and learned_context/ store when this step declares it; a stated absence when the project has neither. See library/tools/project_context.py.

outputs.name: audio_spine
outputs.expected_schema: Every block carries clip_id, source_start, source_end, word_timestamps and alignment_method; None/empty only for non-speech blocks. The spine contract is AGENTS.md section 6 and library/tools/spine_contract.py - not a Pydantic file.

outputs.name: duration_zone
outputs.description: Bridge output: the project's target duration resolved to real numbers (minimum_seconds, target_seconds, maximum_seconds) with the legend that defines the band - the same MEASUREMENT_LEGEND route step 2.04 takes. Emitted only when something declared a target; when nothing did the absence is a fact about the project, not a value to invent (AGENTS.md 10.5). Declared here because the bridge emits it on such runs and validate_step_output otherwise reports it as an unexpected extra field.

llm_outputs.name: structure
llm_outputs.description: Ordered spine blocks. Each block: position ("hook" or int), block_type ("hook"|"speech"|"music"|"picture"|"transition_slot"|"intro"|"outro" - the handoff's own block-type table) and duration_seconds. A "hook"/"speech" block also carries content.passage_ref matching a speech_sequence position (which requires a non-empty body_sequence). A "picture" block carries content.clip_id plus content.source_start/source_end naming the clip span its picture is cut from. A "music" block may carry content.track (one of the chosen tracks) plus content.source_in/source_out naming the span of that file; without one the conducted bed decides. Do NOT write "intro_card", "outro_card" or "end_card" blocks: those are CARDS, they come from the brand template's content.bookends, and the bridge REFUSES the step by name if the plan writes one. "intro" and "outro" are not cards - they are a breath of music and B-roll, they are yours to write, and nothing drops them.

llm_outputs.name: music_bed
llm_outputs.description: How the music is CONDUCTED across the piece - ordered, one entry per piece of music that plays. The bed is not one continuous stretch of one track unless you decide it is: it may be several sections of one track, disjoint sections included, or sections of several tracks. music_selection.splices names the pieces step 2.04 picked out and music_selection.tracks names every track it chose; you decide which piece plays where. Each entry: track (string, the audio_path or title of one of the chosen tracks - omit it for the primary track, which is the single-track case); source_in (number, the second of THAT file this piece starts at); starts_at_block (the spine block position this piece comes in on - REQUIRED on every entry after the first, which starts the video); crossfade_seconds (OPTIONAL number - how long this piece fades up over the one it replaces. Leave it out for a hard splice: that is the absence of a crossfade, not a request for a default one, and nothing substitutes a length); why (string, what in the measurements and in this moment of the edit decided it). Omit music_bed entirely and the one chosen section plays under the whole video - the absence of a decision, not a decision. A piece runs until the next piece comes in, so its length is the blocks it covers; do not name an end.
